title: School kitchen manager fired for giving out free lunches
description: A Colorado public school kitchen manager was fired for giving a student a free lunch for which the hungry student didn't qualify. CBSN's Vladimir Duthiers and Kristine Johnson have the latest on the controversial firing.

asr.full_text: A school kitchen manager in Aurora, Colorado has been fired for buying lunches for students who couldn't afford them. While there are programs to make sure no child goes hungry, some students fall through the cracks. But when Della Curry reached into her own pocket to help, she ended up in the unemployment line. Tom Mustin from our Denver station KCNC has more. Della Curry is out of work and unashamed after being fired by the Cherry Creek School District. And I would do it again in a heartbeat. Della is the former kitchen manager at Dakota Valley Elementary School in Aurora. She lost her job Friday after giving school lunches to students who didn't have any money. I had a first grader in front of me crying because she doesn't have enough money for lunch. Yes, I gave her lunch. Under federal law, students who fail to qualify for the free lunch or reduced lunch program received one slice of cheese on a hamburger bun and a small milk. Della says that meal is not sufficient in many times she paid for lunches out of her own pocket. I'll own that I broke the law. The law needs to change. To qualify for the free lunch program a family of four would have to have a household income of around thirty-one thousand dollars. Below CHANGES. TO QUALIFY FOR THE FREE LUNCH PROGRAM, A FAMILY OF FOUR WOULD HAVE TO HAVE A HOUSEHOLD INCOME OF AROUND $31,000, BELOW $45,000 FOR A REDUCED LUNCH. DELLA SAYS THE STUDENTS SHE HELPED OUT DID NOT QUALIFY FOR EITHER PROGRAM. KIDS, HIS PARENTS MAKE TOO MUCH MONEY TO QUALIFY. BUT A LOT OF TIMES, THEY DON'T HAVE ENOUGH MONEY TO EAT. PARENT DARNELL HILL SAYS DELLA HAD HELPED OUT HIS SON WHEN HE FORGOT HIS LUNCH MONEY. DO SOMETHING DIFFERENT BES son when he forgot his lunch money. Do something different besides fire her. She's trying to help. And now Della is hoping her story will lead to some changes. If me getting fired for it is one way that we can try to change this, I'll take it a heartbeat.
